title: Petra and the Ledger Again
author: Felix Pemberton
blurb: Oscar Thackeray, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
